title: Kodama internal Git service contract v1
description: Messages of docs/contracts/git-service.md: repository resource, Git grant claims, credential exchange, forwarding assertion and worker identity, worker RPC in both directions, push records, ref journal entries, source sets and trigger configuration. Requests, claims and stored records are strict (no additional properties); responses tolerate compatible additions at their top level. Cross-field and cross-element rules a schema cannot express (unique or overlapping source paths, status derived from entry states, one gitFact per update) live in the Go contract.

ManagedBranch.description: A task, agent or run branch: the branches the server may prune.

HumanUpdateCeiling.description: The maximum class set recorded on a human grant; current roles and ref policy restrict every update at use time.

sources.description: Ordered strictly by path; paths are unique and none contains another (checked by the Go contract, not by this schema).
